_dev_notes: POIS vs LOCATIONS -- READ THIS FIRST:
pois.json      = BUTTONS that appear on a map (icon, label, click action).
locations.json = PLACES that exist in the world (hierarchy, events, background art).
A POI button is what the player CLICKS. A location is where they END UP.
Not every location needs a POI (sub-locations are auto-listed from the parent's 'children' array).
Not every POI needs a location (battle POIs trigger a fight, not navigation).
KEY FIELD: parent_location_id
''           = button appears on the WORLD MAP (worldmap.png).
'crestfall'  = button appears on CRESTFALL's interior map (crestfallmap.png).
'home'       = button appears inside the Commander's Quarters.
Any valid location ID works. The button sits at 'position' pixel coords on that location's art.
HOW TO ADD A WORLD MAP POI (pin on the world map):
1. Add entry with parent_location_id: '' and action: 'navigate'.
2. Set target_location_id to the location ID it should open (must exist in locations.json).
3. Set position to pixel coords on worldmap.png (center of where the pin should appear).
4. Set icon_path to an image in assets/art/map/poi/ for a visual marker.
5. World map POIs are hidden until discovered. Add the ID to SaveManager default_profile
discovered_pois array, or call LocationService.discover_poi('poi_id') at runtime.
HOW TO ADD A SUB-MAP POI (button on Crestfall's map, or any other interior map):
1. Add entry with parent_location_id: 'crestfall' (or whatever interior location).
2. Set position to pixel coords on THAT location's background image.
3. For navigation: action: 'navigate', target_location_id: 'destination_id'.
4. For battle:     action: 'battle', battle_id: 'your_battle', enemy_id: 'enemy_id'.
5. Interior POIs are ALWAYS visible -- no discovery required.
FIELDS:
id:                 Unique string, prefix 'poi_' for consistency.
name:               Label shown on the button.
parent_location_id: Which map this button appears ON (see above).
target_location_id: Where 'navigate' action goes. Leave empty for battle POIs.
position:           {x,y} CENTER pixel coords on the parent map's background image.
icon_path:          Image path for the button icon. Empty = text-only button.
category:           Tag for grouping/filtering (city, dungeon, landmark, battle, etc).
unlock_condition:   'flag:flag_name' to gate visibility. Empty = always visible once discovered.
battle_id:          Battle config ID (used when action is 'battle').
enemy_id:           Must match an entry in data/enemies.json (used when action is 'battle').
